# 802.3ah OAM Event Notification (`efm_oam_event_notification`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [PTP / ESMC / CFM / R-APS / 802.3ah OAM (P2)](../../protocols/timing-oam.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `ethertype` = 34825 (0x8809) | 3 (0x03) |
| [`efm_oam`](efm_oam.md) | `code` | 1 (0x01) (re-decodes this layer) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subtype` | `uint(8)` | `3` |   | Slow Protocols subtype (3 = OAM). |
| `flags` | `flags(16)` | `0x50` |   | Flags: link fault, dying gasp, critical event, local / remote evaluating and stable. |
| `code` | `enum(8)` | `1` (event_notification) |   | OAMPDU code: 0x00 Information, 0x01 Event Notification, 0x02 Variable Request, 0x03 Variable Response, 0x04 Loopback Control, 0xfe Organization Specific. |
| `sequence_number` | `uint(16)` | `1` |   | Event notification sequence number. |
| `tlvs` | `tlv` — up to and including the first item of type 0, or the end of the PDU | 2 items |   | Link event TLVs (8-bit type, 8-bit length including the header, Auto): errored symbol period, errored frame, errored frame period, errored frame seconds summary, Organization Specific, closed by the End TLV (type 0). |

### `flags`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 (0x0001) | `link_fault` |
| 1 | 2 (0x0002) | `dying_gasp` |
| 2 | 4 (0x0004) | `critical_event` |
| 3 | 8 (0x0008) | `local_evaluating` |
| 4 | 16 (0x0010) | `local_stable` |
| 5 | 32 (0x0020) | `remote_evaluating` |
| 6 | 64 (0x0040) | `remote_stable` |

### `code`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `information` |
| 1 (0x01) | `event_notification` |
| 2 (0x02) | `variable_request` |
| 3 (0x03) | `variable_response` |
| 4 (0x04) | `loopback_control` |
| 254 (0xfe) | `organization_specific` |

### `tlvs`

- Type 8 bits, length 8 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `end` | (type only, no length or value) |   |
| 1 (0x01) | `errored_symbol_period` | `timestamp`, `window`, `threshold`, `errors`, `error_running_total`, `event_running_total` |   |
| 2 (0x02) | `errored_frame` | `timestamp`, `window`, `threshold`, `errors`, `error_running_total`, `event_running_total` |   |
| 3 (0x03) | `errored_frame_period` | `timestamp`, `window`, `threshold`, `errors`, `error_running_total`, `event_running_total` |   |
| 4 (0x04) | `errored_frame_seconds_summary` | `timestamp`, `window`, `threshold`, `errors`, `error_running_total`, `event_running_total` |   |
| 254 (0xfe) | `organization_specific` | `oui`, `value` |   |
